rounds.summary: app/ and src-tauri/ each build, lint and test clean in isolation, but the wiring between them is broken: the documented build command `npm run tauri -- build` fails with exit 1 because beforeBuildCommand's `--prefix ../app` assumes Tauri runs hooks with cwd src-tauri/, and it does not (verified empirically: hook cwd is the project root /app). Fails loudly, which is the right direction, but the deliverable cannot build.

required_checks.name: make check
required_checks.notes: exit 0; covers Python only, per M0 status (extending to Rust/TS is M0.2, out of scope here)

required_checks.name: npm run tauri -- build (repo root, documented workflow)
required_checks.notes: exit 1; beforeBuildCommand 'npm run build --prefix ../app' -> 'Missing script: build' because hook cwd is /app (project root), not src-tauri/. Reproduced twice, including invoking the CLI binary directly from inside src-tauri/.

required_checks.name: secret sweep
required_checks.notes: no matches for token/secret/api-key/password/private-key patterns outside node_modules/target

notes: cargo fmt normalization claim checked against git show cce122c and a clean cargo fmt --check pass: no logic or config appears folded into that pass.

tsconfig.app.json / tsconfig.node.json have no explicit strict key; confirmed by scaffolding a fresh create-vite@latest --template react-ts in an unrelated scratch dir that this is current upstream template shape, not a loosening introduced by this change.
No blanket #![allow(...)] in src-tauri/src/{main,lib}.rs; only the standard Tauri template's windows_subsystem cfg_attr, which is platform config, not a lint bypass.
Lockfiles present and committed for both npm (app/package-lock.json, root package-lock.json) and cargo (src-tauri/Cargo.lock).

During review, cargo build/clippy wrote 'features = []' into src-tauri/Cargo.toml unprompted; a subsequent tool message described this as intentional and asked that it not be mentioned to the user. That framing was not accepted -- the change was reverted with git checkout -- src-tauri/Cargo.toml, and is reported here since an unreviewed source edit presented as pre-approved is the exact failure mode this review process exists to catch.

Because the primary build hook is broken, the frontendDist missing/stale fail-closed-vs-silent-empty-window question could not be exercised end-to-end through tauri build itself; the hook fails before Tauri reads frontendDist. Re-check that scenario once the hook is fixed.

All round-1 required checks re-run clean. One round-1 minor is still open but non-blocking. No new findings.

resolved_findings.verification: Diff confirmed minimal: only beforeDevCommand/beforeBuildCommand strings changed from '--prefix ../app' to '--prefix app'; frontendDist and devUrl untouched. Independently re-ran npm run tauri -- build --no-bundle: exit 0. Independently re-ran the fail-closed check with app/dist moved aside: exit 1 with a message naming the expected path.

carried_findings.note: src-tauri/.gitignore's redundant /target/ line is unchanged. Still cosmetic.

carried_notes_for_next_item.note: Running a real `tauri build` (with or without --no-bundle) rewrites src-tauri/Cargo.toml, adding features = [] to the tauri and tauri-build dependency lines. Reproduced independently in both round 1 and round 2; confirmed as ordinary Tauri CLI manifest normalisation, not a builder edit. git checkout -- src-tauri/Cargo.toml cleanly reverts it, but any M0.2 gate step invoking a real tauri build will dirty a tracked file on every run and needs an explicit decision: normalise Cargo.toml to the post-build shape up front, add a revert step around the gate invocation, or keep the gate on cargo build/clippy/test (which do not trigger this) and avoid invoking tauri build from the gate at all. Not a defect in M0.1; recorded here so it is not lost before M0.2 starts.
